exposure: intrapartum fever status (fever/no fever) among women receiving epidural analgesia
outcome: change in maternal core body temperature during labor
length of first stage of labor
cohort: Pregnant women attending the institution for a vaginal in-hospital delivery (n=201), with 159 receiving epidural analgesia and 42 not receiving epidural analgesia
finding: Use of epidural analgesia during labor was associated with intrapartum maternal fever, and fever after epidural analgesia was associated with adverse maternal outcomes, independent of neonatal complications.
mod_finding: This study investigated the association between epidural analgesia and intrapartum maternal fever, but did not examine mode of delivery as a variable.
